scenario_title_zh: 梭织规格与染整色差纠纷

rounds.ai_message: Hello, this is Tom from Changshu Weaving Mill. You sent an inquiry for poplin — how can I help?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你好，我是常熟织造厂 Tom。你发了府绸的询盘，请讲。
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要说 'I want poplin cloth'；poplin 就是布名。
rounds.tips_zh: 府绸 poplin 是衬衫常用布；规格要说经纬密和纱支。
rounds.user_response_example: Hello Tom. We need poplin for our men's shirting line. Quantity is around 20,000 meters.

rounds.ai_message: Good. What about the construction? We can do 110 x 76 in 40s x 40s combed cotton, or 96 x 72 in 32s x 32s.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。织物结构呢？40 支 x 40 支精梳棉可做 110x76，32 支 x 32 支可做 96x72。
rounds.common_mistakes: EPI x PPI 是经密 x 纬密；不要写成 110x76 但说成 'density'。
rounds.tips_zh: 高密府绸 110x76 手感挺括；96x72 更柔软。
rounds.user_response_example: We need 110 x 76, 40s x 40s combed cotton. That is our standard premium shirting.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Target GSM is 110, cuttable width 58/60 inches. Do you want greige or finished fabric?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。目标克重 110，可裁门幅 58/60 英寸。要坯布还是成品布？
rounds.common_mistakes: greige 是坯布（未染），finished 是整理后。
rounds.tips_zh: greige 适合自家有染厂的工厂；finished 适合直接裁剪的服装厂。
rounds.user_response_example: Greige for now. We have our own dye house for piece dyeing.

rounds.ai_message: Fine. Loom is Picanol rapier. Lead time for greige is 25 days. For 20,000 m, price is US$1.85 per meter FOB Shanghai.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。用必佳乐剑杆织机。坯布交期 25 天。20,000 米每米 1.85 美元 FOB 上海。
rounds.common_mistakes: lead time 后要接 from the deposit / after confirmation。
rounds.tips_zh: 剑杆织机适合府绸高密品种；交期与工厂在手订单相关。
rounds.user_response_example: Lead time is fine. For 20,000 m, could you do US$1.75 per meter? We may repeat next season.

rounds.ai_message: I can do US$1.80 per meter for 20,000 m. By the way, after weaving you send to the dye house — please confirm the dye house so we can coordinate the loom state vs finished width.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 20,000 米可做到 1.8 美元每米。另外织好后要送染厂，请确认染厂以便我们协调坯布门幅和成品门幅。
rounds.common_mistakes: loom state width 坯布门幅一般比成品宽 2-3 英寸。
rounds.tips_zh: 成品可裁门幅（cuttable width）才是下单关键；坯布门幅更大以补偿缩率。
rounds.user_response_example: Our dye house is Hangzhou Sunlight. Loom state width should be 63 inches to give us 58/60 cuttable after finishing.

rounds.ai_message: Noted. About dyeing — after piece dyeing to Pantone 19-3950 navy, our dye house sent a lab dip. The bulk came back with Delta E 1.8 against the approved sample. This is above our 1.0 tolerance.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。关于染色——匹染到潘通 19-3950 藏青后，染厂出了对色样。大货回厂后 ΔE 1.8，超过我方 1.0 公差。
rounds.common_mistakes: ΔE 不能跟 light source 混谈；要在 D65 标准光源下比对。
rounds.tips_zh: ΔE 1.0 是服装品牌常见大货公差；1.5-2.0 是让步区间；>2.0 多要扣款。
rounds.user_response_example: Delta E 1.8 is too high against our 1.0 tolerance. Was the measurement taken under D65 light source?

rounds.ai_message: Yes, D65 light, 10-degree observer. The bulk is slightly redder than the lab dip. We can offer a 3% discount on this lot, or re-dye at our cost. What do you prefer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 是的，D65 光源、10 度视角。大货比色样略偏红光。我们可以对本批让利 3%，或我方承担费用重染。您怎么选？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在折扣与重染之间做选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 折扣与重染各有时间成本；旺季赶货通常选折扣。
rounds.tips_zh: 重染增加 7-10 天交期；折扣适合赶出货的订单。
rounds.user_response_example: Re-dye please. We cannot ship with Delta E 1.8 to our EU customer. Please re-dye and re-check under D65 before bulk release.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Re-dye will take 8 days, plus 2 days for lab re-check. New bulk will be Delta E within 0.8 guaranteed. We will issue a credit note for the re-dye cost.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。重染需 8 天，加 2 天复样。新批大货保证 ΔE 0.8 以内。我方将开具重染费用的贷记通知。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认时间表与贷记通知
rounds.common_mistakes: 贷记通知（credit note）确认后要写入下一张发票抵扣。
rounds.tips_zh: 贷记通知是双方留底的正式扣款凭证，避免口头承诺。
rounds.user_response_example: Credit note received, thank you. 8 days re-dye is acceptable. Delta E within 0.8 guaranteed — please confirm in writing.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, Tom from Changshu Mill. I understand you have a weave-plus-dye RFQ for men's premium shirting. Before I quote the greige, may I confirm whether you want yarn-dyed stripes or piece-dyed solid?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Mark，我是常熟厂 Tom。明白你有梭织+染整的 RFQ 做男式高档衬衫。报坯布价前请确认你要色织条还是匹染素色？
rounds.common_mistakes: yarn-dyed 与 piece-dyed 价格和交期差别大，不要混说。
rounds.tips_zh: 匹染适合素色和基础款；色织条适合条纹衬衫。
rounds.user_response_example: Piece-dyed solid for this style — 4 solid colors. Yarn-dyed stripes will be a separate PO next quarter.

rounds.ai_message: OK. For piece dyeing, I need to confirm the dye recipe. Are you using reactive dye on 100% cotton, or do you need a blend?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。匹染需要确认染整配方。是 100% 棉用活性染料，还是混纺？
rounds.common_mistakes: reactive dye（活性染料）多用于纤维素纤维；涤纶要用 disperse dye（分散染料）。
rounds.tips_zh: 全棉匹染用活性染料是标准；CVC / T/C 混纺要看涤纶比例。
rounds.user_response_example: 100% cotton, reactive dye. Standard recipe is fine, but please use a leveling agent for even shade.

rounds.ai_message: Fine. About weaving — we have rapier loom (Picanol) for high-density poplin. EPI 110, PPI 76, 40s x 40s combed cotton, loom width 63 inches, finished cuttable 58/60 inches. GSM target 110 ± 5. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。关于织造——我们用必佳乐剑杆机织高密府绸。经密 110、纬密 76、40 支 x 40 支精梳棉，坯布门幅 63 英寸，成品可裁 58/60 英寸。目标克重 110 ± 5。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: GSM ± 5 是行业默认；品牌定制可要求 ± 3 但要加价。
rounds.tips_zh: 克重公差 ± 5 是常见；± 3 需要工厂配小钢筘并挑匹，工艺成本高。
rounds.user_response_example: 110 ± 5 GSM is acceptable, but we need the EPI and PPI within ± 2 for our premium shirting. Can you hold that?

rounds.ai_message: Yes, we can hold EPI/PPI ± 2. About the dye house — last season your dye house had a shade claim on lot #B115, Delta E 2.3 against approved lab dip. Are we using the same dye house this time?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以，经纬密可控制在 ± 2。关于染厂——上季度你方染厂 B115 批次 ΔE 2.3 高于封样。这次还用同一染厂吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要回避历史 ΔE 问题；坦诚承认 + 改善方案是最好回应。
rounds.tips_zh: 染厂 ΔE 不稳定通常源于染料批次差异或染色工艺波动；改善要给出具体方案。
rounds.user_response_example: Same dye house, but we have done a root cause analysis. They have switched to a new lot of reactive dye and added an online spectrophotometer for shade check.

rounds.ai_message: Good. To prevent a repeat, I suggest we do a pre-production trial of 500 meters first to confirm the shade before bulk release. Your cost will be the same as bulk. Are you OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。为防重演，我建议先做 500 米大货前试织，确认色光后再放全批大货。你方成本与全批相同。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: pre-production trial（试织）通常由买方买单；但色差导致可转嫁卖方。
rounds.tips_zh: 试织 200-500 米是行业标准做法；色光达标后才放全批，可降低全批索赔风险。
rounds.user_response_example: 500 m pre-production trial is acceptable. We pay for the trial, but if the shade fails again, the cost transfers to the dye house.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed. After the 500 m trial comes back from dyeing, we measure Delta E under D65. If Delta E is above 1.0, we re-dye; below 1.0, we release bulk. What's your ceiling — 1.0 strict, or 1.5 with a 2% discount?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。500 米试织回厂后，我们用 D65 测 ΔE。ΔE 高于 1.0 就重染；低于 1.0 放全批。你的上限是 1.0 严格，还是 1.5 接受 2% 折扣？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在严格标准与折扣让步之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 标准高（1.0）= 风险低但成本高；让步（1.5+折扣）= 成本低但客户关系紧张。
rounds.tips_zh: 高档品牌客户（EU/US）通常坚持 ΔE ≤ 1.0；中端可接受 1.5。
rounds.user_response_example: For our EU customer, strict Delta E 1.0 is mandatory. We cannot ship 1.5 to them. Please re-dye until we are within 1.0.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. I will build the re-dye cost into the quote as a contingency. Final price: greige US$1.80 per meter, dyeing US$0.45, total US$2.25 per meter FOB Shanghai for 20,000 m. TT 30/70. Lead time 30 days after lab dip approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。我会把重染成本计入报价作为预备。最终价：坯布每米 1.8 美元，染色 0.45 美元，合计每米 2.25 美元 FOB 上海，20,000 米。TT 30/70。批色样后 30 天交期。
key_phrases: price is on the high side
rounds.common_mistakes: 总报价包含织造 + 染整时要拆分明细，方便议价。
rounds.tips_zh: 织造 + 染整拆分报价更利于议价；坯布与染色单价独立可控。
rounds.user_response_example: 30 days after lab dip approval is acceptable. The dyeing part US$0.45 is on the high side — for 20,000 m, can you do US$0.40?

rounds.ai_message: I can do US$0.42 for dyeing on 20,000 m, but the US$0.03 discount stays one-time. I will issue the PI today. Please confirm within 3 working days so we can lock the loom slot.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 20,000 米染色可以做到每米 0.42 美元，但 0.03 美元的折扣仅此一次。我今天发 PI。请 3 个工作日内确认以便锁定织机档期。
rounds.common_mistakes: 织机档期紧张时，确认 PI 要快；口头承诺不算。
rounds.tips_zh: 旺季（5-9 月）织厂档期紧张，PI 确认慢会丢档期。
rounds.user_response_example: 3 working days is fine. We will review the PI today and arrange the deposit by Friday to lock the loom slot.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Tom from Changshu. Before we open this order, I need to flag a capacity issue — our rapier loom capacity is fully booked through July. I can give you a slot starting August 5 with delivery September 10. Does that work?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是常熟 Tom。开单前要说明产能——我们剑杆机 7 月前档期已满。8 月 5 日开织、9 月 10 日交期。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在延期与替代之间决策
rounds.common_mistakes: 旺季延期时不要简单说 'expedite'；要给出可替代方案。
rounds.tips_zh: 旺季延期可考虑：分单给二厂、加价 10% 抢档、改空运赶首批。
rounds.user_response_example: August 5 is too late for our September retail launch. Can you split the order — 10,000 m on your loom, 10,000 m with your sister mill? We pay the small mill surcharge.

rounds.ai_message: Possible. My sister mill in Suzhou has one Picanol rapier loom free. Same quality, same yarn, same pricing. They can deliver 10,000 m by August 25. Is that workable?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以。我苏州姊妹厂有一台必佳乐剑杆机空闲。同样品质、同纱、同价。8 月 25 日交 10,000 米。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认姊妹厂方案与品质一致
rounds.common_mistakes: 姊妹厂（sister mill）品质一致性是关键风险；要做预审。
rounds.tips_zh: 姊妹厂品质一致性要靠 yarn batch + machine type + audit 三重保障。
rounds.user_response_example: Sister mill is acceptable, but we need a pre-shipment audit and confirmation that both mills use the same yarn lot and Uster Statistics Bulletin level.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Pre-shipment audit will be done by our QA manager in Suzhou on August 20. Same lot guaranteed. Now about quality — your spec sheet calls for 'no visible barre'. What is your definition — machine assessment, or third-party?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。我方 QA 经理 8 月 20 日在苏州做预审。同一批号保证。关于质量——你规格写 '无可见纬档'。定义是厂内自评还是第三方？
rounds.common_mistakes: barre（纬档）检测方法不明确会引起争议；要写明。
rounds.tips_zh: barre 检测可用 4-point system 评级，或 AATCC 灰卡评级；写明方法减少争议。
rounds.user_response_example: For visible barre, we accept machine assessment on a 4-point scale. Anything above grade 3 on the AATCC gray scale is a major defect.

rounds.ai_message: Good. One more quality risk — your last shipment in March had a shrinkage complaint of 4.2% warp and 3.8% weft, exceeding the 3% spec. Was that pre-shrunk or compacted?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。还有一个质量风险——你 3 月那批缩水率经 4.2%、纬 3.8%，超过 3% 规格。那批做预缩还是压光？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 解释缩水问题原因与改善
rounds.common_mistakes: pre-shrunk ≠ sanforized；前者是自然预缩，后者是机械预缩，效果差异大。
rounds.tips_zh: sanforizing（机械预缩）才能保证缩水 ≤ 3%；仅自然预缩不可控。
rounds.user_response_example: That lot was pre-shrunk only, not sanforized. We will add a compactor pass on this order to guarantee shrinkage under 3% both directions.

rounds.ai_message: Compactor pass accepted. Now the dye house issue — last season we had a US$4,200 claim on a shade dispute that was settled at 50/50 because we could not prove the dye house was solely at fault. This time I want a clear chain of custody.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 接受压光。关于染厂——上季一起 4,200 美元色差索赔按 50/50 分摊，因为无法证明染厂全责。这次我要清晰的监管链。
rounds.common_mistakes: chain of custody 不明确会让索赔扯皮；要在 PO 里写清楚。
rounds.tips_zh: 染厂 chain of custody：从坯布进厂到出缸，每步留样与签字。
rounds.user_response_example: We will add a chain-of-custody protocol in the PO: each dyeing lot gets a spectrophotometer reading at start, mid and end, with joint sign-off by our QC and the dye house manager.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Final pricing — I can hold the August 5 slot for 20,000 m greige at US$1.80 + US$0.45 dyeing = US$2.25 per meter, but only if we receive the 30% deposit within 5 working days. Otherwise the slot goes to another buyer.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。最终价——20,000 米坯布 8 月 5 日开织，每米 1.8 美元 + 染色 0.45 美元 = 2.25 美元，但 5 个工作日内收 30% 定金才锁档。否则档期给别的买家。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在锁档与让价之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 旺季锁档靠定金，没到账的承诺不算。
rounds.tips_zh: 旺季定金到账日 = 锁档日；提前与财务对齐电汇时间。
rounds.user_response_example: Deposit within 5 working days is firm on our side. I will instruct finance to wire by Tuesday. Please confirm receipt immediately.

rounds.ai_message: Confirmed — once the deposit hits our account, the August 5 slot is locked. Now, the Delta E tolerance — your customer requires strict 1.0, but our dye house argues 1.2 is achievable with cost saving. Will you accept 1.2 with a 1.5% allowance, or push for 1.0 strict?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 确认——定金到账即锁 8 月 5 日档期。关于 ΔE 公差——你客户要求严格 1.0，但染厂说 1.2 配合成本节省可达成。你接受 1.2 加 1.5% 让利，还是坚持 1.0？
rounds.common_mistakes: ΔE 1.2 vs 1.0 看似差异小，但对色牢度和客户满意度影响大。
rounds.tips_zh: 深色（藏青/黑）对 ΔE 更敏感；浅色（米白/浅灰）可适当放宽。
rounds.user_response_example: For dark navy (Pantone 19-3950), strict 1.0 is mandatory. For the lighter colors we can accept 1.2 with the 1.5% allowance. Please mark this per-color in the PI.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed — per-color Delta E tolerance, with the 1.5% allowance only on lighter shades. I will issue the revised PI today with all the new terms: slot, compactor, chain of custody, per-color Delta E. Please counter-sign by Wednesday.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意——按色设定 ΔE 公差，1.5% 让利仅适用浅色。我今天发修订 PI，含所有新条款：档期、压光、监管链、按色 ΔE。请周三前回签。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 与回签时限
rounds.common_mistakes: 修订 PI 与原始 PI 条款差异要逐项核对，避免漏项。
rounds.tips_zh: 修订 PI 用 red-line 对照版本，逐项批注，避免执行时扯皮。
rounds.user_response_example: Revised PI received. I will do a red-line comparison with our internal spec sheet and counter-sign by Wednesday. Deposit will be wired Tuesday to lock the slot.
